result.topic_en: A printed Latin doctoral diploma from Göttingen, dated 14 March 1866 and issued under King George V of Hanover, in which Dean Carl Friedrich Heinrich Marx confers the degree of Doctor of Medicine, Surgery and Obstetrics on Johann Robert Brandmann of Hamburg.
